plugins.description: Searches Domus Aedes' own portfolio of homes to buy, rent long-term or stay in across Spain and Morocco (short stays on the Costa del Sol, in Catalonia, Marrakech and Casablanca). Each brief returns the best matches — up to six — plus refinement suggestions, full property details, and a request-details form that reaches a Domus Aedes advisor.
